chunks: From him, from Fadalah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"The takbir (saying Allahu Akbar) over the deceased is five takbirs."

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرُ: The act of saying 'Allahu Akbar' (God is the Greatest), a key component of the funeral prayer.
key_terms.خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ: Five takbirs, referring to the specific count of divine glorifications in the ritual.

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs are recited in the Shia funeral prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from Tahdhib al-Ahkam confirms the standard Shia practice of reciting five takbirs during Salat al-Mayyit, a ruling derived from the Prophet’s tradition and upheld by the Imams. While some early reports mention fewer takbirs, the consensus among major Shia jurists (fuqaha) favors this five-takbir format as the normative ritual structure. It underscores the continuity of prophetic practice within the Ja'fari school of jurisprudence.
